annotations.title: How to work a cold email problem (playbook)

description: Returns WarmInboxes' diagnostic playbook for a cold email problem: the questions to ask the person, the checks to run in order from cheapest to most expensive (with the tool for each), what WarmInboxes' published studies measured a finding to cost (for example that a SURBL listing left reply rate flat, while Google's domain-reputation refusal cost about 43% of replies), the guides and studies to read with full URLs, and the evidence that would make new domains or inboxes the right fix. Give a symptom in the person's words, or a scenario id; with neither it lists the scenarios. Runs no check and looks nothing up.

scenario.description: A scenario id, when the problem is already known.

symptom.description: The problem in the person's words, e.g. "reply rate dropped by half this month" or "my domain is listed on SURBL".
